articles.title: Man sought for allegedly stealing poppy donation boxes
articles.summary: The Durham Regional Police Service (DRPS) has released an image of a suspect who allegedly stole poppy donation boxes from two separate locations in Bowmanville earlier this month. articles.title: Community holds protest at Finch West TTC station after boy injured in arrest last month
articles.summary: Nearly 100 people from the Jane and Finch community held a protest against police violence Friday outside of Finch West station where a 14-year-old boy was injured during an arrest last month. The protest was organized by Jane Finch Action Against Poverty (JFAAP) and the Jane Finch Education Action Group alongside TTCriders and Showing Up […]

articles.title: Seven teams chosen for 24 Sussex Drive design competition
articles.summary: The federal government says seven teams have been selected to take part in a design competition to restore the prime minister’s official residence at 24 Sussex Drive in Ottawa. The 35-room mansion was built over 1867 and 1868 as a private residence. It was expropriated in 1949 to become the official residence of the prime […]

articles.summary: The lucky winner of the 680 NewsRadio 50/50 Fortune raffle’s first early bird draw was announced Thursday. articles.summary: Three teenagers were arrested and four firearms were seized after police spotted an allegedly stolen vehicle in North York. Toronto police said officers were in the area of Dufferin Street and Lawrence Avenue West conducting patrols for Project HIDE, an enforcement initiative targeting home invasions, around 2 a.m. on Thursday. articles.title: Suspect identified in fatal stabbing on TTC bus in Scarborough
articles.summary: Toronto police investigators have identified a suspect after a man was fatally stabbed on a TTC bus in Scarborough on Thursday night. Nicholas Crawford, 40, of Toronto, is wanted for second-degree murder. Officers were called to the Eglinton Avenue East and Falmouth Avenue area, near Danforth Avenue, at around 10:04 p.m. for reports of a […]

articles.title: Senior dead 2 weeks after being hit by car in Scarborough
articles.summary: An 83-year-old man has died nearly two weeks after he was struck by a driver in a vehicle in Scarborough, Toronto police say. The 60-year-old female driver remained at the scene after the crash, they said.

articles.title: Water service back in downtown Mississauga following repairs to water main break
articles.summary: A water main break in downtown Mississauga that shut down city hall, the Living Arts Centre and Hazel McCallion Central Library on Friday has been repaired, Peel Region officials said early Friday afternoon.

articles.title: Man, 34, dead after stabbing on TTC bus in Scarborough
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating after a man died following a stabbing on a TTC bus in Scarborough on Thursday evening. Police are looking for a 40-year-old man wanted for second-degree murder.

articles.title: The crisis at the corner of Queen & Bathurst
articles.summary: Queen and Bathurst feels like ground zero for the city's drug and homelessness crisis. Outreach workers and businesses say it's escalated since the corner's supervised consumption site closed. In this episode of This is Toronto, CBC's Haydn Watters shadows a team responding to overdoses and trying to ease the pain.

articles.title: 2nd suspect arrested in shooting death of woman downtown in June, police say
articles.summary: Toronto police say they have arrested a second suspect in the shooting death of a woman downtown in June.

articles.title: Anti-Black racism may have played a role in Jamal Francique's death, mother tells inquest
articles.summary: The mother of a man who was fatally shot by police during an attempted arrest in Mississauga, Ont., told a coroner's inquest today she believes anti-Black racism played a role in her son's death.
